units.memory: bytes; README MB uses decimal 1000000 bytes
units.throughput: saved responses per second including validation, grading, persistence, and finalization

scope: Single measurements during development of 0.4.0; baseline and serial streaming measured before adding parallel execution. These are not release-version performance guarantees.
limitations: Shared Linux host; single run per condition; machine and storage dependent.
Repeated five-domain walkthrough tasks favor parser caches and warm OS cache.
25ms RSS sampling can miss short peaks; summed process RSS double-counts shared pages.
Original and preparallel measurements did not record an implementation source hash; baseline commit is recorded and parallel development source hash is retained.
Baseline output embeds every detailed result; streaming output is a compact receipt plus journal and SQLite checkpoint. Comparing only final receipt bytes would understate storage.

previous_in_memory.method: 25ms /proc RSS sampling; peak sum of live evaluator and descendant RSS; handwritten repeated five-domain inputs, four responses per prompt; warm OS filesystem cache; no model calls

streaming_before_parallel.method: 25ms /proc RSS sampling; peak sum of live evaluator and descendant RSS; handwritten repeated five-domain inputs, four responses per prompt; warm OS filesystem cache; no model calls

streaming_two_workers.workload: Repeated frozen Level 1 walkthrough, five domains, four saved responses per prompt.
streaming_two_workers.method: 25 ms /proc RSS sampling; sum of live evaluator and descendant RSS, including shared pages counted per process; local /tmp SQLite checkpoint; warm OS cache; no model calls; single measurement per condition.
streaming_two_workers.limitations: RSS sampling can miss short peaks; shared-page double counting; repeated tasks favor parser caches; results are machine/workload specific, not a performance guarantee.
